user.title: Connect to CATCH Control
user.description: Close Configurator on your phone. Choose a discovered device or enter its Bluetooth address. A password is optional for monitoring; provide the local device password to enable schedule changes.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check Bluetooth range, close the phone app, and verify the device address. Password-based controls require 2CH firmware 12718.
error.invalid_auth: The local device password was not accepted.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported CATCH Control 2CH.

init.title: CATCH Control options
init.description: Leave the password blank to keep it. Clear the password to return to monitoring only. Times in schedules use the device clock.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the configured Catch. Close Configurator and check Bluetooth availability.
error.invalid_auth: The local device password was not accepted.
